scope: axis-aligned, single cylindrical subtractive feature in the existing prismatic-hole-v1 family
question: Which B-Rep facts, excluding reference-script labels, can distinguish a bounded blind cylindrical cut from a through cylindrical cut?

fixed_oracles.boundary: These records are deterministic sequence oracles only. Their sequence labels may score an audit result after measurement, but may not be used as an input fact or selector.

required_measured_facts: cylindrical face identity and axis convention
each cylindrical-face boundary edge and adjacent face identities
for every axis-normal adjacent planar face: normal, local bounding box, loop/containment relation, and axial position
whether both axial ends connect to exterior boundary faces under the recorded adjacency convention
measurement tolerance and any unavailable or non-manifold fact

available: face surface type, per-entity bbox, parameter range, sampled normals, global topology counts
current_probe_boundary.consequence: The current public probe results cannot yet support a blind/through decision. M30-001 creates no positive observable unit and changes no runtime probe.

classification_rule.blind: Only if exactly one terminal planar face is demonstrated to be an interior cut floor and the opposing end is an exterior opening under the frozen measured-fact convention.
classification_rule.through: Only if both axial ends are demonstrated to be exterior openings under the frozen measured-fact convention.

negative_controls: counterbore records are out of scope and must not be collapsed to blind or through.
a cylindrical face without complete adjacent terminal facts must return unsupported.
reference-script variant, feature name, or face enumeration order must be rejected as an input to classification.
stopping_rule: Do not infer original CAD history.
Do not claim generic cylindrical-feature recognition.
Do not add a runtime probe, helper, manifest, provider input, parser behavior, or feature classifier from this design.
If an offline audit cannot establish the required facts with stable entity-local evidence, retain unsupported rather than manufacture a pair.
next_work: A separately selected M30-002 may add an offline-only measured-fact reporter and audit the frozen records; candidate assets require a further preregistered workpack if existing records do not discriminate.
